storyIntro: I'd only meant to go for a short walk. By the time I reached the end of the coastal path, the sun was almost down.
caption: The sea seen from the path.
storyBody: The path stopped at the rocks. I found a flat one to sit on and tipped the sand out of my shoes. Someone nearby was fishing. I watched for quite a while, but he didn't catch a thing.
storyExcerpt: I sat on a rock and tipped the sand out of my shoes.
storyEnding: The walk back was all uphill, and I started to get hungry. I still had half a bottle of water in my bag, warm from the sun.
bringBody: Just a bottle of water. I was hungry on the way back.
paceBody: There were only rocks ahead. I found a flat one to sit on.
planBody: I took the same path back. The hill hadn't seemed this long on the way down.
leaveBody: I'd emptied them at the beach. Back home, more sand fell out of my socks.
